messages.missingCause: There is no `cause` attached to the symptom error being thrown.
messages.incorrectCause: The symptom error is being thrown with an incorrect `cause`.
messages.includeCause: Include the original caught error as the `cause` of the symptom error.
messages.missingCatchErrorParam: The caught error is not accessible because the catch clause lacks the error parameter. Start referencing the caught error using the catch parameter.
messages.partiallyLostError: Re-throws cannot preserve the caught error as a part of it is being lost due to destructuring.
messages.caughtErrorShadowed: The caught error is being attached as `cause`, but is shadowed by a closer scoped redeclaration.
